root.description: The id of the root the path is under

path.description: The file the condition is about (a package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml), relative to its root; `.` for the analysis root itself

code.description: `WORKSPACE_MEMBER_NO_ROWS`: a member's package.json has no rows this run, so its name, version and dependencies are unknown; `WORKSPACE_MEMBER_EXCLUDED`: a member's package.json is routed away from the data instance (an exclude), so its name, version and dependencies are unknown; `WORKSPACE_TARGET_UNKNOWN`: a dependency names no member with rows while some member's name is unknown (WORKSPACE_MEMBER_NO_ROWS or WORKSPACE_MEMBER_EXCLUDED), so it may name that member; targetPath is null; `WORKSPACE_DUPLICATE_NAME`: two members a dependency's name can reach carry one name, at each of them; a dependency on that name has targetPath null; `WORKSPACE_PATH_UNRESOLVED`: a `workspace:`, `file:` or `link:` path names no member's directory (a tarball, a directory outside the workspace, an absolute path, one leaving the analysis root), or is a `workspace:` path under a manager with no path form; targetPath is null; `WORKSPACE_PACKAGES_MALFORMED`: the member pattern list is not an array of strings, or pnpm refuses the file for a missing `packages`; VAT reads what it can and says so; `WORKSPACE_ROOT_REFUSED`: this root's workspace rows are refused (the message leads with the refusal code) while other roots answer; the root has no package or dependency rows; `WORKSPACE_ROOT_MAY_BE_ABOVE`: the analysis root declares no workspace, holds a package.json and sits below its repository's top level, so a workspace above it may hold its packages; path is `.`; `WORKSPACE_ROOT_OUTSIDE_ROOT`: a package.json under an analysis root that declares no workspace declares a `workspace:` dependency, so its workspace root may lie above the analysis root; at that package.json; `WORKSPACE_NOT_DECLARED`: the manager reads no workspace at the root although one may be meant: yarn 1 and a root package.json with workspaces but without private: true (at the root package.json), or pnpm with no pnpm-workspace.yaml and a package.json under the root declaring a `workspace:` dependency (at that package.json); `WORKSPACE_MANAGER_INFERRED`: the root names no packageManager (or yarn without a version), and VAT read the manager from which files exist at the root, never their content; the message names them and what the inference decided; path is `.`; `WORKSPACE_MANAGER_UNKNOWN`: the manager is unknown (no packageManager and no lockfile or several managers' lockfiles, yarn of unknown flavour, or a manager VAT does not know; path `.`), or a dependency whose target depends on it: the root package's name, or a `workspace:` path (at the member, targetPath null); `WORKSPACE_MANAGER_VERSION_UNKNOWN`: pnpm-workspace.yaml has no packages key, whose meaning pnpm changed at 10.5.0, and the pnpm version is unknown; VAT reads the root only; path is `.`

seq.description: 0-based position among the path's conditions of this code

projection-workspace-conditions.description: A row of the derived `workspace_conditions` relation
